# PhishGuard - AI Phishing Threat Intelligence & URL Analysis Platform

> PhishGuard is an advanced AI-powered phishing detection engine that performs multi-layered lexical analysis, DNS/WHOIS telemetry extraction, SSL inspection, and NLP heuristics to classify suspicious URLs and email vectors in real time.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Vector Threat Scanning**: Ingests URLs, domains, and raw email messages to decompose attack surfaces including typosquatting, IDN homograph attacks, brand spoofing, and obfuscated redirects.
- **Lexical & Structural Analysis**: Computes URL entropy, suspicious keyword densities, subdomain nesting depth, IP-in-URL evasion, and obfuscated encoding patterns.
- **Network & DNS Telemetry**: Inspects ASN reputation, domain registration age, MX records, DMARC/SPF/DKIM alignments, and SSL certificate issuer authority.
- **NLP Email Analysis**: Evaluates urgency triggers, spear-phishing syntax, credential harvesting forms, and masquerading sender addresses.
- **Dual-Theme Design System**: Supports high-density dark cyber telemetry and editorial paper minimalist design systems.

## Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide Icons, Vite.
- **Backend**: FastAPI / Python microservice with ML classifiers (Random Forest, TF-IDF NLP, heuristics).
- **Deployment**: Production SPA deployed to Vercel at https://phishingdetector-nyzxis.vercel.app/

## Part of the 5-Part Cybersecurity & AI Defense Suite by Arfa Danial
1. **APIShield** (API Security Gateway & WAF): https://apishield-pi.vercel.app/
2. **MalGuard** (AI Malware Scanner & Sandbox): https://malguard.vercel.app/
3. **VulnShield** (Vulnerability Intelligence & CVE Scanner): https://vulnshield.vercel.app/
4. **KeyVault** (Password Security Analyzer & Entropy Engine): https://pwsec-nyz.vercel.app/
5. **PhishGuard** (Phishing URL & Domain Threat Detector): https://phishingdetector-nyzxis.vercel.app/
